Overview.text: Revenues for the quarter were $14.1 million, a $0.4 million increase from the prior year period.

Market Positioning and Growth Outlook.text: The increase in operating loss and higher selling, general and administrative expenses indicate a weakening competitive position.

insight.text: Insight: Operating loss of $23.6 million increased $10.7 million and adjusted operating loss of $21.3 million increased $10.9 million, both as compared to the prior year period, primarily due to higher selling, general and administrative expenses and direct operating expenses. [earnings_release.txt, line 26]

text.ed17aac93a11.L23.text: For the fiscal 2027 first quarter, revenues of $14.1 million increased $0.4 million, or 3%, as compared to the prior year period. This primarily reflected higher revenues from league distributions of $1.2 million, mainly due to an increase in certain league distributions unrelated to national media rights fees, partially offset by other revenue decreases.

text.ed17aac93a11.L25.text: Selling, general and administrative expenses of $28.1 million increased $5.8 million, or 26%, as compared to the prior year period. This increase was primarily driven by (i) expenses related to the spin-off transaction in the current year period of $3.6 million and (ii) higher employee compensation and related benefits of $1.4 million.

text.ed17aac93a11.L26.text: Operating loss of $23.6 million increased $10.7 million and adjusted operating loss of $21.3 million increased $10.9 million, both as compared to the prior year period, primarily due to higher selling, general and administrative expenses and direct operating expenses.

Valuation Insights.text: Revenue increased modestly year‑over‑year while operating loss expanded, suggesting top‑line growth was not matched by profitability.
